reason_for_revision: A graph-check attempt found ENSURE_ROOT's 409 behavior was described only in prose, so v1 was not fully machine-checkable as a transition system. v2 makes every tested transient/error branch explicit.
name: deterministic-content-CAS retry state machine

operational_semantics.RECONSTRUCT: Fetch authoritative HEAD/root and current blob SHA.
operational_semantics.CHECK_APPLIED: Use stable op_id; already-authoritative operation is a no-op success.
operational_semantics.DERIVE_CANDIDATE: Derive candidates from current authority, never from stale planned snapshots.
operational_semantics.ENSURE_IMMUTABLE_OBJECTS: Create canonical objects at deterministic paths.
operational_semantics.FETCH_AND_COMPARE_OBJECTS: Reuse an existing deterministic path only if canonical content is equal.
operational_semantics.FETCH_AND_COMPARE_ROOT: Reuse existing deterministic root only if canonical content is equal.
operational_semantics.PUBLISH_CAS: Update HEAD with the blob SHA fetched in current RECONSTRUCT.
operational_semantics.READBACK: Success requires authoritative readback of expected op/root.
operational_semantics.RATE_LIMIT_WAIT: Persist exact continuation; obey retry-after/reset/backoff; resume at reconstruction rather than repeating mutation blindly.
